Frequently asked questions

Here's everything you need to know to get started, manage your account, and troubleshoot the most common issues.

How quickly will you respond to my message? −
We aim to respond to all enquiries within 24 hours on business days. Sales and enterprise enquiries are typically handled within a few hours.
Can I book a demo before signing up? +
Absolutely. You can book a free 30-minute demo with one of our product specialists. Just fill in the contact form and select "Get In Touch" as your subject.
Do you offer custom enterprise plans? +
Yes. Our enterprise plans are fully customisable — including dedicated infrastructure, custom SLAs, SSO, and white-glove onboarding. Contact our sales team to discuss your needs.
Where are your offices located? +
Our headquarters is in New York, USA. We also have remote teams across Europe and Asia. All support is handled globally so you'll always reach someone in your time zone.
How do I reach technical support? +
You can reach our support team via the contact form above, live chat in the app, or by emailing support@quikit.ai. Growth and Enterprise users get priority queue access.
Is there a partner or reseller programme? +
Yes. We have an active partner programme with revenue sharing for resellers and integration partners. Email partners@quikit.ai to get started.
Can I request a refund? +
We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. Contact our support team and we'll process your refund within 3–5 business days.
Is my data safe with Quikit? +
Yes. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never sell or share it with third parties.
